probe.note: Probe loads the page at its DEFAULT camera. Attempt 1 reframed the isometric preset onto the hero band, so most of the plan is now frustum-culled at that framing and the probe reads far below the true scene cost — it is a floor, not a representative load. The capture set renders the full scene correctly at all 8 presets with clean consoles. Budget is a ceiling, so this passes either way; the representative figure to watch at the optimization pass is the writer's analytic estimate (~185 draws / ~17.4k tris) plus the 25 new distance-bounded PointLights, whose cost is fragment-side and invisible to a draw/tris probe.

zone_luminance_ladder.method: wall pixel luminance through sRGB -> ACES -> sRGB at exposure 1.08, same shellWarmWhite albedo in every band (so this measures lighting, not paint)
